metadata.title: Hypersurfaces with constant sectional curvature of a product of two space forms
metadata.abstract: We complete the classification of hypersurfaces with constant sectional curvature of dimension greater than or equal to three in the product of two space forms.

analysis.progressType: 乘积空间形超曲面分类
analysis.workSummary: 完成两个空间形的乘积中、维数至少为三且截面曲率恒定的超曲面分类。
analysis.breakthrough: 补齐空间形乘积中恒截曲率超曲面的分类。
analysis.limitations: 超曲面维数至少为三；结论不自动涵盖二维曲面或更高余维子流形。

analysis.priorityReason: 自然齐性环境中的恒曲率子流形分类。

analysisBasis.abstract: We complete the classification of hypersurfaces with constant sectional curvature of dimension greater than or equal to three in the product of two space forms.
